$comment: schema_version 0.1.0; validates replay_result.yaml written by nova replay.
title: ReplayResult
description: Output manifest of a NovaFabric replay run. Written to .novafabric/replays/<replay-id>/replay_result.yaml.

replay_id.description: ULID uniquely identifying this replay run.

replay_of_run_id.description: run_id of the source capsule being replayed.

start_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the replay started.

end_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the replay finished.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the replay in milliseconds.

policy_flags_used.description: Safety ladder flags active during this replay.

env_warnings.description: Environment differences between recorded env.lock and current runtime.

model_calls_mocked.description: Number of model calls served from cache. In mocked mode (ADR-0300) this is the number of recorded responses the dispatcher actually served, counted from its event log.

tool_calls_mocked.description: Number of tool responses served from the capsule. ADR-0300: only mocked mode installs a tool dispatcher, and only on mcp.ClientSession.call_tool; every other mode reports 0 (ADR-0261).

tool_calls_available.description: Recorded tool calls on a surface a tool dispatcher can serve (MCP tools/call, ADR-0300). Additive and optional (ADR-0261); not a claim that any were substituted. See tool_calls_recorded for every recorded call.

tool_calls_recorded.description: Every tool call the capsule recorded, whatever its surface. Additive and optional (ADR-0300).

model_calls_available.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): recorded model responses the dispatcher can serve (supported provider surface, successful call, a recorded choice). Additive and optional.

model_calls_unmatched.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): model calls the replay made that had no recorded response to serve (queue exhausted, provider/order mismatch, malformed record, or a refused unsupported surface). Additive and optional.

tool_calls_live.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): calls on the intercepted tool surface that executed live (only possible with --permissive). Calls on surfaces replay does not intercept are not observed and not counted here. Additive and optional.

tool_calls_unmatched.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): calls on the intercepted tool surface with no unconsumed recorded result. Additive and optional.

queues_fully_consumed.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): every servable recorded model response and MCP tool result was consumed. Additive and optional.

divergence_reason.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): the first divergence from the recorded run, with a count of any others. Absent when the replay followed the recording. Additive and optional.

replay_contract.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): divergence policy, intercepted surfaces, recorded/live/unconsumed counts and the list of divergences. Additive and optional. ADR-0304 adds the observed live network connections.

model_errors_replayed.description: Issue #16: recorded SDK errors mocked replay raised again as the SDK's own exception class (also counted in model_calls_mocked).

network_observed.description: ADR-0304: the replayed process reported its outbound connections (socket connect observer installed).

network_connections_live.description: ADR-0304: IPv4/IPv6 connection attempts the replayed Python process made (observed, never blocked). A lower bound when network_connections_capped is true.

network_connections_capped.description: ADR-0304: more connections were made than the observer logs per process.

network_observation_scope.description: ADR-0319: what network_connections_live counts -- sockets of the replayed Python process (and of Python children that load the replay dispatcher), never those of a non-Python child process.

model_calls_not_servable_by_system.description: ADR-0319: recorded model calls mocked replay cannot serve, by gen_ai.system: their count and up to 10 endpoint host[:port]. Non-empty only under --permissive (a strict replay refuses to start); they ran live if the workload made them.

child_processes_observed.description: ADR-0319: the replayed process reported the child processes it started (audit hook installed).

child_processes_spawned.description: ADR-0319: processes the replayed Python process started (subprocess, os.system, posix_spawn, fork, exec); their network and file activity is not observed. A lower bound when child_processes_capped is true.

child_processes_argv0.description: ADR-0319: distinct basenames of the programs started, first 10 (never arguments).

child_processes_capped.description: ADR-0319: more child processes were started than the observer logs per process.

tool_calls_live_by_tool.description: Intercepted or observed tool calls that ran live, by surface and tool name (first 50 pairs); the CLI names each as a [LIVE] tool call line.

tool_calls_live_by_tool_not_listed.description: Distinct (surface, tool name) pairs left out of tool_calls_live_by_tool.

tool_calls_not_served_by_surface.description: ADR-0306 D1, under --permissive: recorded tool calls mocked replay does not serve by policy (LangChain tools not passed through wrap_tools), by surface; each one made ran live and is counted in tool_calls_live.

model_calls_not_servable.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0319): recorded model calls on a surface mocked replay cannot serve (an unserved provider, or a served surface with no recorded response). A strict replay refuses to start when this is non-zero (error.type ModelSurfaceNotServable). Additive and optional.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the replayed command (mocked mode only).

model_calls_not_servable_by_system.description: ADR-0319, on error.type ModelSurfaceNotServable: the unservable recorded model calls by gen_ai.system.

tool_calls_not_served_by_surface.description: On error.type ToolSurfaceNotServed: the recorded tool calls mocked replay does not serve by policy (LangChain tools not passed through wrap_tools), by surface.

error.description: Error details if status is failure or aborted.

schema_drift.description: Tool calls whose stored arguments/result no longer conform to their declared *_schema_ref (ADR-0128). Additive, optional; recorded in every mode, gating only in exact.

fidelity.description: Mocked mode, experimental (ADR-0321): outcome equivalence of the replay with the recorded run. `status` keeps its meaning (how the replayed process ended), so a faithful replay of a run that failed has status failure and verdict faithful. Additive and optional.

verdict.description: faithful: every computed check equal, no divergence, no live or unintercepted call. diverged: a computed check is unequal. failed: the replayed command did not run to completion (refused, timed out, not launched, dispatcher not installed). not_compared: the capsule lacks the recorded exit code or output streams, or its file-effects record is present but unusable (incomplete, redacted, not matching its evidence digest) or names a file that could not be compared. A capsule with no file-effects record at all (captured before it existed, a non-Python workload, a container or batch runner) is not not_compared on that account: file_effects is listed in unchecked and the verdict does not cover it. Never faithful by default.

normalization.description: The declared, versioned volatile-token rule set the normalised checks used (ADR-0321 amendment): volatile-ids/1 masks RFC 4122 UUIDs in stdout_normalized_sha256 and nothing else. none: no check normalised anything (a replay refused before it ran).

unchecked.description: Required checks the capsule holds no record for at all (today only file_effects): each is equal null, the verdict is decided by the other checks and does not cover it. Additive (ADR-0321 amendment).

name.description: exit_code, stdout_normalized_sha256, stdout_sha256, stderr_sha256, file_effects, file_writes_not_recorded, model_call_sequence, tool_call_sequence, divergence, live_calls, tool_result_echo; more may be added.

equal.description: null when the check could not be computed.

recorded.description: The recorded value (an exit code, a sha256:<hex> digest, a call sequence, a count; for file_effects the number of recorded written files).

replayed.description: The replayed value, in the same form (for file_effects the number of those files the replay wrote again, and so compared).

normalizer.description: The rule set this check's values went through (stdout_normalized_sha256 only).

differences.description: file_effects: the recorded written files the replay wrote again whose state after the replay differs; file_writes_not_recorded: files only the replay wrote (recorded: not written). First 50. A state is a sha256:<hex> digest or absent, not_regular, too_large(<n> bytes), unreadable.

path.description: Relative to the working directory, ~/... under the home directory, else absolute.

advisory.description: true: reported but never decides the verdict (stdout_sha256 and stderr_sha256, the raw byte comparisons, and file_writes_not_recorded, ADR-0321).

replay_capsule_ref.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0321): the replay capsule's manifest, relative to the replay result directory; `nova diff <capsule> <replay-dir>` compares the two runs. Additive and optional.
